_comment: THE FOUNDATION'S RULES, AS THIS GAME SETS THEM (DECISIONS #154). server/build.rs compiles this into the module, and the client reads it (foundation/core/rules.gd). Change a number, republish (tools/publish.sh), restart. Movement has its own file (movement_config.json); a genre's content has its own (shared/fishing/).

rate_limits._comment: HOW OFTEN ONE PLAYER MAY CALL A REDUCER (REVIEW 0.23.1 B3). burst: calls allowed at once; per_sec: how fast that allowance comes back. A call over it is refused with an error and changes nothing. Reducers not named here take default, and only the reducers that call spend_rate are limited (the ones that write rows everyone receives, or move a player between worlds). An honest client stays far inside these: the fight is reported five times a second, a look or the equip state only when it changes.

sessions._comment: Session kind 0, the one client_connected joins: fishing's rounds. The machine goes round the phases in this order; entering phase 0 (LOBBY) starts a new round (scores reset, a fresh seed). Seconds 0 holds a phase until a reducer moves it on. Phases 0-3 are the foundation's (LOBBY, PLAYING, RESULTS, SHOP); a genre numbers its own from 4.

lobby._comment: THE LOBBY (DECISIONS #174). ready_up: the round starts as soon as every player here has said they are ready (R), when there are at least min_players of them; otherwise when the lobby's time runs out. teams: the teams a player picks from in the lobby (T), by name, numbered in this order; empty for none. A new player is put on the smallest team.

match._comment: THE MATCH (DECISIONS #182): the rounds a world plays from the first player's arrival until the last one leaves, counted for players from round 1. wait_s: how long the first lobby of a match waits for its players (0: with ready_up, until every player here is ready; without, the lobby's own seconds). end_after_empty_s: how long a world may have no player online before its match ends, so a dropped player can come back to it; after that the world waits, and nothing is played or counted.
